title: NIM Models
description: Browse the 200 most recently updated registered models. Click a model_id to inspect metadata, source resources, and calibration weights. The dropdown lists up to 500 recent models. Registry browsing is independent of the dashboard time range.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
    SELECT 'All models' AS __text, 'all' AS __value, 0 AS priority, NULL::timestamptz AS updated_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT name || ' · ' || id::text, id::text, 1, updated_at
    FROM models
) options
ORDER BY priority, updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 501

panels.title: Models — click model_id to drill down

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    m.id::text AS model_id,
    m.name,
    m.type,
    m.version,
    array_to_string(m.tasks, ', ') AS tasks,
    array_to_string(m.architectures, ', ') AS architectures,
    m.source->>'type' AS source_type,
    m.source->'value'->>'type' AS local_source,
    m.source->'value'->>'provider' AS provider,
    jsonb_array_length(m.weights) AS calibrations,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at
FROM models m
WHERE (${model:sqlstring} = 'all' OR m.id::text = ${model:sqlstring})
ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.id
LIMIT 200

value.title: View model source and calibration weights

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    m.id::text AS model_id,
    m.name,
    m.type,
    m.version,
    m.tasks::text AS tasks,
    m.architectures::text AS architectures,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at
FROM models m
WHERE m.id::text = ${model:sqlstring}

SELECT
    m.id::text AS model_id,
    m.source->>'type' AS source_type,
    m.source->'value'->>'type' AS local_source,
    m.source->'value'->>'provider' AS provider,
    m.source->'value'->>'id' AS source_id,
    m.source->'value'->>'base_url' AS base_url,
    COALESCE(m.source->'value'->'resource'->>'uri', m.source->'value'->>'uri') AS uri,
    COALESCE(m.source->'value'->'resource'->>'format', m.source->'value'->>'format') AS format,
    COALESCE(m.source->'value'->'resource'->>'path', m.source->'value'->>'path') AS cached_path,
    COALESCE(m.source->'value'->'resource'->>'size', m.source->'value'->>'size')::numeric AS size_bytes,
    m.source::text AS source
FROM models m
WHERE m.id::text = ${model:sqlstring}

SELECT
    m.id::text AS model_id,
    w.ordinality AS position,
    w.value->>'type' AS type,
    (w.value->>'a')::double precision AS a,
    (w.value->>'b')::double precision AS b,
    w.value::text AS weights
FROM models m
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.weights) WITH ORDINALITY AS w(value, ordinality)
WHERE m.id::text = ${model:sqlstring}
ORDER BY w.ordinality
